title: Scribe: doc updates for TYPE-YEAR-seq ID format
problem: Documentation references bare numeric IDs and does not mention the learning type in note examples. After the ID format change, all docs need to reflect the new format.
description: Update all documentation to reflect the new TYPE-YEAR-seq ID format: 1. scribe/CLAUDE.md: notes table includes learning type, document TYPE-YEAR-seq format with examples, explain per-(type, year) counters. 2. core/commands/wrapup.md: handoff command examples use new ID format. 3. core/commands/backfill-handoffs.md: agent template uses new IDs. 4. core/commands/apiary-context.md: update any examples citing numeric IDs. 5. scribe/commands/notes.md: add 'learning' to type list, update ID parsing docs for TYPE-YEAR-seq. 6. docs/reference/cli-tools.md: update scribe CLI reference.
scope: Modified: scribe/CLAUDE.md, core/commands/wrapup.md, core/commands/backfill-handoffs.md, core/commands/apiary-context.md, scribe/commands/notes.md, docs/reference/cli-tools.md
